name: rwaUSDi
oneLiner: rwaUSDi is Multipli's KYB-gated credit class backed by private credit, structured finance, project finance, asset-backed loans, and market-neutral funds.
collateral: Isolated basket of institutional credit assets: private credit, structured finance, project finance, asset-backed loans, plus market-neutral fund strategies (Nomura, Fasanara, Edge Capital), with periodic NAV and scheduled non-instant redemption.
pegMechanism: NAV-based valuation of underlying RWA basket; KYB-gated 1:1 minting and redemption restricted to verified institutional counterparties

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Multipli documents rwaUSDi and its unwind/peg module across multiple EVM deployments, with no external bridge protocol resolved. The reviewed route is issuer/protocol-native issuance and redemption mechanics across supported chains.

mintAuthority.summary: rwaUSDi Ethereum and Base owner() both return a Gnosis Safe 1.4 proxy (0xf25c) with 3-of-7 signers on ETH and 3-of-5 on Base. No modules detected. Implementation at 0x2a66. All mint and upgrade paths flow through the same Safe.

Seven owners traversed via linked list at mapping slot 2: 0x8c7c (EOA), 0xe9ed (EOA), 0xc57d (EOA), 0x705f (nested 1-of-1 Safe, EOA owner 0x8db6), 0x4976 (EOA), 0x2179 (EOA), 0x0b29 (EOA). Modules sentinel = 0x1 (none-detected). Implementation at 0x2a66bb2da3ad1c854e79307f64b862decd860d4c. Base chain same owner address with 3-of-5 configuration (ownerCount=5, threshold=3, nonce=7).

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25294865: owner() on both ETH and Base rwaUSDi returns 0xf25c (Gnosis Safe 1.4 proxy). ETH Safe: 3-of-7 (7 signers: 6 EOAs + 1 nested 1-of-1 Safe), no modules. Base Safe: same address, 3-of-5 configuration. No proxy admin slot set. Implementation confirmed at 0x2a66 (23116 bytes). owner() on impl = 0xf25c (same Safe). No permissionless mint route; all issuance gated by KYB and Multipli's Safe multisig.
